description: Source code for front panel control in a device, including LED brightness, blinking patterns, and power state management, with external dependencies on device indicators and configuration.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, blinking patterns, and preferences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Helper class representing blinking pattern information for LEDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes device indicators and power state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts front panel indicator control, initializes blinking and power indicators.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timer and halts indicator updates.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the current power status of the device.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of all front panel indicators.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the clock display (if enabled).

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current clock display brightness.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all front panel indicators.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all front panel indicators.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Configures LED indicator with color and brightness parameters.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for an LED indicator.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current front panel preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Saves front panel preferences to file.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from file.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Begins blinking pattern with specified repeat count.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking pattern.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED color and brightness for blinking pattern.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blinking timer to update LED state.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format to 24-hour.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour format.
